2 Ensuring Uniform Load distribution
Dynamo uses consistent hashing to partition its key space across its replicas and to ensure uniform load distribution.

q: what mechanism does dynamo use to capture causality between different versions of the same object
a: Dynamo uses vector clocks [12] in order to capture causality between different versions of the same object.

q: what quorum-like technique keeps writes available when some replicas are temporarily down
a: Using hinted handoff, Dynamo ensures that the read and write operations are not failed due to temporary node or network failures.

q: what structure is used in anti-entropy to synchronize divergent replicas
a: Dynamo uses Merkle trees for anti-entropy as follows: Each node maintains a separate Merkle tree for each key range (the set of keys covered by a virtual node) it hosts.

q: what load distribution did dynamo choose for uniform performance across nodes
